claims: Chuck Norris starred as Cordell Walker in the CBS series "Walker, Texas Ranger" from 1993 to 2001.
Norris played Cordell Walker, a Texas Ranger and former U.S. Marine.
Cordell Walker used martial arts to fight crime.
"Walker, Texas Ranger" ran for nine seasons.
"Walker, Texas Ranger" ran on CBS from 1993 to 2001.
"Walker, Texas Ranger" spawned a TV movie "Walker, Texas Ranger: Trial by Fire" (2005).
"Walker, Texas Ranger" launched the "Chuck Norris facts" meme phenomenon.
In 2010, then-Texas Governor Rick Perry named Norris an honorary Texas Ranger.
Norris described the honorary Texas Ranger distinction as one of the highest honors of his life.
"Walker, Texas Ranger" was filmed in Texas.
"Walker, Texas Ranger" featured extensive stunt work choreographed to highlight Norris's martial arts background.
Norris often performed action sequences in "Walker, Texas Ranger".
Reports in March 2026 indicate the actor passed away at age 86.
